theorem PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.exact_marked_quantitative (hAGG : PaperCV3Audit.Process.ProcessAGGStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (betaMin betaMax epsilon eta : Real)
  (hbetaMin : LT.lt 0 betaMin) (hbeta : LT.lt betaMin betaMax) (hepsilon : LT.lt 0 epsilon) (heta : LT.lt 0 eta) :
  Exists fun Nzero =>
    ∀ (N : Nat),
      GE.ge N Nzero →
        ∀ (L E : Nat),
          LE.le (HMul.hMul betaMin (Real.log ↑N)) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
            LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd ↑L ↑E) 2) (HMul.hMul betaMax (Real.log ↑N)) →
              And
                (LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.exactDistance N L E)
                  (HMul.hMul 32 (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.exactError N L epsilon eta)))
                (LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.signedDistance N L E)
                  (HMul.hMul 32 (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.exactError N L epsilon eta)))
name: PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.exact_marked_quantitative

theorem PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.aggregate_hard_budget (hStein : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.DirectionalSteinFactorsStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (betaMin betaMax c c' epsilon : Real)
  (hbetaMin : LT.lt 0 betaMin) (hbeta : LT.lt betaMin betaMax) (hc' : LT.lt 0 c') (hcc : LT.lt c' c)
  (hepsilon : LT.lt 0 epsilon) :
  Exists fun Nzero =>
    ∀ (N : Nat),
      GE.ge N Nzero →
        ∀ (L : Nat),
          LE.le (HMul.hMul betaMin (Real.log ↑N)) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
            LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) (HMul.hMul betaMax (Real.log ↑N)) →
              ∀ (A : Set PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.Sample),
                MeasurableSet A →
                  LT.lt 0 (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.sourceMeasure A) →
                    LE.le 1 (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.fullRate N L)) →
                      LE.le
                          (HAdd.hAdd (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.information A)
                            (Real.log (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.fullRate N L))))
                          (HSub.hSub (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log ↑N))
                            (HMul.hMul c (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))) →
                        LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.thresholdDistance N L A)
                          (HAdd.hAdd
                            (HMul.hMul 2
                              (Real.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg c') (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))))
                            (HPow.hPow (↑N) (HAdd.hAdd (Neg.neg (1 / 3)) epsilon)))
name: PaperCV3Audit.Patterns.aggregate_hard_budget
